final: WITH per_type AS (SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.tradereg) AS trader_count FROM transactionrecord AS tx JOIN trader AS tr ON tx.trdref = tr.tradereg GROUP BY tr.tradekind), stats AS (SELECT AVG(trader_count) AS avg_count, SUM(trader_count) AS total_count FROM per_type) SELECT p.tradekind, p.trader_count, p.trader_count * 1.0 / s.total_count AS share_of_total, p.trader_count - s.avg_count AS above_average_by FROM per_type AS p CROSS JOIN stats AS s WHERE p.trader_count > s.avg_count
